false_negatives.finding: Retained ordered rows accept arbitrary compressed_sha256 and support_sign_sha256 values. M1323 checks only lowercase SHA syntax and M1227 checks only payload basenames; neither binds row metadata to the actual payload or recursive seal row.

operator_runtime and atlif_activity identities are count-only. Completely invented unique names with calls=40 pass, so the claimed frozen runtime populations are not identity-bound to the exact 247-module ordered inventory.
Attention Q/K/gate validation requires only key presence and nonzero size. String Q, floating K and boolean gate arrays with incompatible geometry pass after valid record and recursive resealing.
The no-canonical-residue gate uses Path.exists(). A broken symlink at the canonical path is misreported as absent and source-self-check returns PASS while residue remains.

The env-python3 shebang selects this host's Python 3.6, which cannot parse from __future__ import annotations. Source and test fail before execution; the contract pins neither Python>=3.7 nor the NumPy-bearing interpreter used for the author 13/13 result.
